beers.name: 1820 Brewing Wave Finder IPA
beers.description_excerpt: Wave Finder by 1820 Brewing is a non-alcoholic IPA crafted for those who crave bold flavor without the buzz. Its satisfying profile invites another sip, offering all the character of a traditional IPA with none of the compromise.
